rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent stepped mass with a clear dominant gesture across all four views, not just a one-view trick. The orange solid consistently resolves as a low, compact, terraced bar with a carved central void/cut, and the top view confirms the same spatial rule rather than hidden collisions. The blue access edge is answered by a visible open seam/void on the site-facing side, so the ground response is semantically aligned rather than sealed. It is still somewhat box-derived, but the stepped section and courtyard figure give it enough program support for neighborhood living. Reference resonance is strongest with the terraced/courtyard neighborhood precedents and weaker with the more elaborate campus-scale ones.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise composition with a carved central void and bridge-like upper connection; good precedent for active threshold plus coherent mass split.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Larger campus/tower ensemble is more expansive than this compact neighborhood mass; transfer the courtyard logic, not the scale.
